implement.approach: Regression-first: rateLimit_nat_budget.test.ts drives the REAL handler through the __wf__ session harness (fake GoTrue) and fails on BASE (commit 66bd409a, extended in ed5c85d5). Fix (96a0f658): rateLimit.ts records Auth refusals per presented credential — SHA-256(trimmed raw token), one aligned window per refusal kind ('authfail_cred' / 'authfail_live') — and keeps the per-IP 'authfail' counter as a stuffing SIGNAL only. Hold rule (admitAuthCredential/peekAuthFailureBudget): a credential with >=30 refusals of either kind in the window is 429; when the egress has produced 30 credential refusals, only credentials that egress already had refused AS CREDENTIALS are fast-failed; never-refused credentials (valid bearer, fresh sign-in, idle handset refresh) always reach Auth; liveness-only credentials are never fast-failed (a dead session keeps hearing 401). Liveness classification (authRefusalKind) on GoTrue error_code/message. Edge-local refusals (no bearer, expired exp) and Auth outages/5xx/malformed charge nothing (only Auth-issued 401s are marked via markAuthRefusal and charged via chargeMarkedAuthRefusal). Parallel replays of an already-refused credential are bounded by per-isolate in-flight reservations (reserved only when the shard is non-zero, so a valid bearer's fan-out is never throttled; counts+reservations read in one synchronous segment on the memory path so the bound is exact). Memory store is bounded and expiry-aware; a full store drops the record (fails open). No minted-credential registry (which caused the r6 25 h-idle and isolate-restart breaks): admission depends only on the credential's own refusal record, so a fresh isolate/memory fallback admits every not-yet-refused credential and a pre-restart dead session is classified by its GoTrue code, not by a registry. index.ts wiring is the minimal hunk (listed in out_of_scope_files).

implement.approach: Regression-first: rateLimit_nat_budget.test.ts drives the REAL handler through the __wf__ session harness (fake GoTrue) and fails on BASE (commit 66bd409a, extended in ed5c85d5). Fix (96a0f658): rateLimit.ts records Auth refusals per presented credential — SHA-256(trimmed raw token), one aligned window per refusal kind ('authfail_cred' / 'authfail_live') — and keeps the per-IP 'authfail' counter as a stuffing SIGNAL only. Hold rule (admitAuthCredential/peekAuthFailureBudget): a credential with >=30 refusals of either kind in the window is 429; when the egress has produced 30 credential refusals, only credentials that egress already had refused AS CREDENTIALS are fast-failed; never-refused credentials (valid bearer, fresh sign-in, idle handset refresh) always reach Auth; liveness-only credentials are never fast-failed (a dead session keeps hearing 401). Edge-local refusals (no bearer, expired exp) and Auth outages/5xx/malformed charge nothing (only Auth-issued 401s are marked via markAuthRefusal and charged via chargeMarkedAuthRefusal). Parallel replays of an already-refused credential are bounded by per-isolate in-flight reservations (reserved only when the shard is non-zero, so a valid bearer's fan-out is never throttled; counts+reservations read in one synchronous segment on the memory path so the bound is exact). Memory store is bounded and expiry-aware; a full store drops the record (fails open). No minted-credential registry (which caused the r6 25 h-idle and isolate-restart breaks): admission depends only on the credential's own refusal record, so a fresh isolate/memory fallback admits every not-yet-refused credential and a pre-restart dead session is classified by its GoTrue code, not by a registry. index.ts wiring is the minimal hunk (listed in out_of_scope_files).
